rubric: Same page, another defect: a wrong currency is not a dead button.

reading.why: Same page, but a wrong currency and a dead button have different causes and different fixes: fixing one leaves the other.

ruledOut.question: slot1
ruledOut.label: same
ruledOut.why: Repairing the Pay button leaves the currency wrong, so fixing one does not fix the other.

ruledOut.question: slot1
ruledOut.label: related
ruledOut.why: They share only the page; the criterion for related asks for a shared area or cause, and the causes are unrelated.
